dict.string: Reclaim scans your Desktop for large, duplicate and look-alike files. Nothing leaves your Mac, and removals always go to the Trash.
Reclaim scans your Documents for large and duplicate files. Nothing leaves your Mac, and removals always go to the Trash.
Reclaim scans your Downloads for old installers, archives and large files. Nothing leaves your Mac, and removals always go to the Trash.
Reclaim can map and scan folders on external drives you choose.
Reclaim can map and scan folders on network drives you choose.
Reclaim asks Finder to empty the Trash or remove an app that needs your administrator password.
